description: NaIn(TeO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbca space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.98 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing InO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-1.93 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.62 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one In, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent In, and one Te atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one In, and one Te atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Te atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one In, and one Te atom.
